items.title: NATO: Rutte says US troop withdrawal won't hurt Europe
items.description: NATO's Mark Rutte said US troop reductions in Europe will be structured and not harm defenses. The Trump administration has been aggressive and unclear about the drawdown but a US pivot has been in the works for years.
